title: Snackpack: Minimal runnable SDK examples for Next.js, FastAPI, Go HTTP server, and CLI focusing on retries and streaming ergonomics
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: ship a tiny, well-documented set of runnable example projects (Next.js, FastAPI, Go HTTP server, and a CLI) that illustrate recommended retry strategies, resumable streaming consumers, backoff tuning, and pragmatic error handling for Redwood SDKs. The Snackpack must be small (<200 LOC per example where possible), copy-paste friendly, and include CI lint/test templates. Use these in docs, quickstarts, and the onboarding repo.
acceptance_criteria: Each example boots in <2 minutes with environment variables and a provided README
Retry examples show exponential backoff, idempotency tokens (where applicable), and circuit-breaker note
Streaming examples demonstrate both chunked UI streaming (Next.js/React) and a resumable file-download consumer (Go/Python) with KV-cache usage notes
Automated tests (unit + integration smoke) run in CI and pass using mocked responses
Examples are referenced from SDK docs and a short blog draft for launch
tasks: Draft minimal Next.js streaming page with server-side/provider example and client-side resume handler
Build FastAPI example showing sync and async handlers, streaming generator, and retry decorator for idempotent calls
Author Go HTTP server that exposes /generate and a CLI that consumes streaming responses with graceful reconnects
Create a tiny CLI example (Python+Go) demonstrating token refresh, retry semantics, and --dry-run option
Write READMEs, usage snippets, and a short smoke test matrix for CI
Add cross-linking to SDK docs and register examples in the examples index
